app.name: Zira
app.supportStatement: Zira does not decide; it supports the decision of the agronomist and the farmer.

placeholder.note: This screen gets its content in Phase {phase}. Only the frame is ready for now.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Shows the state of the system in ten seconds; no analysis happens here.
items: Registered fields and the last NASA data update
Completed and pending analyses
Alerts for missing data, sensor faults and risk
Map of field locations

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Every field is an independent record with its own profile: location, soil, crop, irrigation.
items: Add a field by drawing its boundary on a map
Soil type, rainfed or irrigated, crop and variety
Field detail page and analysis status

fieldMemory.title: Field Memory
fieldMemory.description: Works out from satellite imagery whether the field was cropped or fallow in each of the last 10 seasons.
items: 10-year NDVI time series
Cropped and fallow periods, with a confidence level
Warnings for cloudy or missing imagery
Confirmation by the user and the agronomist

waterVault.title: Water Vault
waterVault.description: Shows how many millimetres of usable water the soil holds on the decision day.
items: Precipitation, irrigation input, ET0 and ETc
Daily water balance and usable water (mm)
Satellite versus sensor difference and the uncertainty range
Pick a date to see the past water balance

rotation.title: Rotation and Zira Card
rotation.description: Compares three rotation strategies on the same field under the same conditions.
items: A: current rotation, B: water-dependent flexible rotation, C: legume rotation
In how many of 25 seasons the water was enough, with its uncertainty range
Rationale, data evidence, benefit, information gap and local review risk for each strategy
Zira Card preview and agronomist approval

dataCenter.title: Data Center
dataCenter.description: Shows that NASA data really arrives and is processed.
items: Connection status of POWER, Landsat, MODIS, SMAP, GPM and GRACE
Last successful fetch and the fetch history
Missing or faulty records and API error logs

settings.title: Settings
items: Users and roles
Cooperative and institution records
API keys and configuration

waterVault.noFieldsDescription: The Water Vault is calculated from a field's NASA data. Add a field first.
waterVault.window: The result rests on {days} days of data from {start} to {end}.

draft.title: Calculated with draft parameters
draft.body: These parameters still wait for an agronomist's sign-off; the result may change after it:

assumptions.fallow_before_the_day: The field is assumed to have been fallow for the {days} days before the day. The crop history arrives with Field Memory (phase 5).
assumptions.regional_weather: Rain comes from NASA POWER. It is a regional product of roughly 50 km resolution, not a measurement taken on the field.
assumptions.no_sensor: There is no sensor data, so the range is shown wide. A sensor (phase 7) corrects the model state.
assumptions.range_from_soil_and_fallow_efficiency: The low and high values come from the water range of the soil texture and from the fallow efficiency shifted by ±{delta}.

charts.storageAria: Line chart of the water stored in the root zone and the soil capacity
charts.et0Aria: Line chart of daily reference evapotranspiration

et0Blocker.no_elevation: ET0 needs the elevation of the field. It is written to the field profile when NASA data is fetched.

season.title: Crop season: ETc, actual ET and stress
season.blocked: The lengths of the growth stages for {crop} are not set yet (config/crops.yaml). The agronomist sets them for the Konya calendar. Until then the crop season is not calculated and no invented value is shown.

errors.no_weather_data: There is no NASA data for this field yet. Fetch the 25 years from the field page.
errors.no_soil: The field's soil profile is missing.
errors.season_type_not_set: The sowing season (autumn or summer) of this crop has not been set by the agronomist yet. You can continue by choosing a date.
errors.date_after_data: The chosen date is beyond the data. The data ends on {last_date}.
errors.not_enough_history: There is not enough data before the chosen date. The data starts on {first_date}; the earliest date you can choose is {earliest_date}.
errors.too_many_gaps: There are too many missing days in the period of the calculation ({missing_days} of {days}); the result would not be reliable.
errors.generic: The Water Vault could not be calculated. Try again.
